title: Explicit entropy bounds for symmetric nearest-neighbor subshifts
summary: We provide another approach to Friedland's result that the topological entropy $h$ of a symmetric nearest-neighbor subshift is computable. Instead of the previous algebraic technique, our approach is mostly combinatorial and involves only counts of locally admissible patterns $C_n$ of a cube $[1,n]^d$ in $\mathbb Z^d$. The main idea is a reflection-gluing construction: we flip admissible patterns and merge them along their boundaries.
